```python
import pandas as pd
from sklearn.cluster import DBSCAN

def task_func(data, cols):
    df = pd.DataFrame(data)
    X = df[cols] if cols is not None else df
    dbscan = DBSCAN(eps=3, min_samples=2)
    df["Cluster"] = dbscan.fit_predict(X)
    return df
```
